(278)dbang chen rdo rje gro bo lod kyi sgo nas sreg pa hom gyi gzer kha bskal pa'i me chen bzhugs/ /༄༅/gtum chen 'jigs dpa' me dang gnam lcags tha

tei:div.tei:p: dbang chen rdo rje gro bo lod kyi sgo nas sreg pa hom gyi gzer kha bskal pa'i me chen bzhugs// ༄༅/ gtum chen 'jigs dpa' me dang gnam lcags thog /brgya byin rdo rje 'bar bas mtshon min pa'i/ drag shul ri rab 'bum bsnyil nga ro can// bla ma kro dha lo kirta la 'dud// bskal me 'bum 'dra'i byi za'i lces// rgyal 'gong dam sri rtsa sbur bzhin// zos te mi shigs 'od gsal dbyings// bskyel byed hom gyi gzer kha 'di'i// de la sreg pa hom gyi las ni// drag po'i gnas dus su// bkra mi shis pa'i sa sna dang*// drag po'i sa sna/ spyin po rnams sbyar ba la grub pa'i maṇ+ḍal gru gsum rgyar mda' gang*/ dpangs sor lnga pa/ dug khrag gis dmar nag tu byugs pa'i steng du ma traṃ gyi lto bar chos 'byung gru gsum/ zla gam gsum/ 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi mu 'khyud kyis bskor ba'i lte bar rdo rje sngon po/ rtsibs dang mchan bzhi/ sgo bzhi rnams su thig le sngon po/ kha gyer rim gsum par khro bo'i rdo rje nag po ra gdengs pas bskor ba'i khar tsher ma can gyi shing ngam/ dur khrod kyi 'gal dum lta bu'i shing las thab khung gru gsum pa rgyar sor nyi shu/ dpang du sor gcig gis dman pa dug khrag gis sbags shing ro thal rnga mo dang bong bu'i sbangs kyis byug pas brtsigs pa'i shar lho'i mtshams su me tshang bca'/ me srog 'dzin pa'i rdzas/ gong gi shing las (280) grub pa'i yam shing mthe'u chung nyi shu'i sbom phra tsam la srid du sor bcu gnyis pa rtsang gi dbyibs can rtse mo gnyis la dug khrag gis sbags pa'i rtsa ba'i rdzas/ 'gugs 'dren yid ches par byas pa'i liṅga rkang lag brgyangs te ngu ba'i rnam pa bskrad ling gi dbyibs can dang*/ shog ling dang*/ 'bru nag gi zan ling grangs mang*/ drag po'i rdzas sha sna bag phye bsres pa'i ril bu/ gnad dbab rdzas sbal sbrul nya khyi bya phag sogs kyi sha dug sna dang bsres pa/

gsod pa'i rdzas/ lcags zangs rdo yi phye ma/ myos pa'i rdzas mar nag dme gnol gyi khrag dang sbyar ba dang*/ tsha ba'i rdzas til mar yungs dkar/ tsha ba gsum ste/ drag po'i rdzas bdun dang*/ mar khu la mi rta ba lang sogs srog chags sna tshogs kyi tshil mang bsres pa/ de rnams thod pa lcags snod gyo ma sogs drag po'i snod du blugs te ro ras sam phung ro'i steng du me ltar 'bul rgyu nyung zad dang bcas tsho gnyis g.yas ngos su bshams/ yang na/ drag po'i rdzas nas tsha ba'i rdzas bar dang*/ sha tshil sna tshogs/ til nag yungs nag lan tsha/ thal chen/ nim ba'i lo ma/ rke tshe rnga mo dang bong bu'i rbang*/ ro skra/ mi rus/ khrag sna/ thun rdzas sogs bag phye dang sbags te ril bur dril/ g.yon ngos su chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod/ khrag gi (281) ar+ghaṃ sngon du 'gro ba'i nang gi nyer spyod/ 'das ma 'das kyi dmar gtor sha khrag gis brgyan/ mdun du sman raka dgang blugs/ las bum/ thod rnga/ rdor dril/ me tog rlung g.yab/ ku sha gos zung*/ rdo shwo'i so rtsi/ gdab kha'i yo byad rnams dang*/ lcags slang*/ lcags sgyed/ chang gar ma'am a rag mar nag bskol sa'i chas sogs nyer mkho rnams bsgrigs/ thab dang slob dpon bar du me yol bam̐ yig dang gangs ri bris pa'ang bzhag go phrin las kyi gzhung tshogs mchod lhag ma yan song nas/ sgrub pa po drag po'i chas su zhugs/ dur khrod kyi ras la zhing chen bris pa'i rten la tsog pu'am mgar ba'i 'dug stangs kyis kha lhor phyogs pas snying rje khros pa'i bsam pa dang ldan pas/ las bum gyi nang du hūm̐ las khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba bskyed bstim/ bzlas pa cung zad byas/ bum chu g.yon bskor gyis gtor zhing*/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bh+wa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du triḥlas gdon bgegs kyi sha phrag phung khams skye mched las byung ba'i mchod rdzas dang sreg rdzasarnams so so'i mtshan nyid (282)yongs su rdzogs shing rang rang gi drag po'i las rab 'byams bsgrub par nus pa/

ngo bo sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ a hūm̐/ nas/ shab+ta'i bar dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā bā ling+ta te dz+wa ba ling+ta ba la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ye swa hā: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta sa man+ta maṇ+ḍal la hūm̐ phaṭa: zhes dang*/ bsreg rdzas/ oṃ badz+ra shri gro bo lod gnod byed tri mā ra ya dza dza: zhes brlab/ spor lde thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du bzung nas g.yon bskor du lan gsum bskor zhing*/ rtsa sngags bzlas te gdol pa/ bshan pa dme yug gi me las byung ba'i ting lo sbar pa dang bcas/ oṃ ag+ne ha bya ka bya dza: gnod byed che ge mo mā ra ya phaṭa dz+wa la raṃ: zhes me sbar/ oṃ ag+ne gdon bgegs dam sri 'byung po dz+wa la raṃ: zhes pas rtsa skam cung zad bcug cing blugs gzar lan gsum gyis me gso/ hūm̐ gsum brjod de rlung g.yab kyis me sbar/ rtsa ku sha ma nyams pa thogs la/ (283)oṃ badz+wa satwa āḥ zhes bzlas nas/ oṃ: ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge: tshangs pa lha rnams dag byed yin: dkon mchog gsum po mnyes byed pa: sa las skyes pa 'dab ma'i snying : bdag gi bgegs rnams thams cad ni: zhi zhing bkra shis mdzad du gsol: zhes ku sha gnyis gshib thog mar rtse mo lho ru bstan/ rim bzhin g.yon bskor gyis snga ma'i rtses phyi ma'i rtsa ba mnan mthar ku sha'i chun po ba glang gi rna ba lta bu'i rtse mo las mthun gyi phyogs su bstan te g.yogs/ thab bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje nag po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las drag po'i thab khung nag po zur gsum pa bang rim gsum ldan kha khyer la khro bo'i rdo rjes mtshan pa zab cing rgya che ba'i nang du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa raṃ yig gis spras pa'i dbus su raṃ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las drag po'i me lha nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yon gan+dhe (284)dang g.yas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgyas bgrang phreng 'dzin pa/

gos nag po bgos shing*/ srad bu nag po'i se ral kha 'phyangs pa/ me lce nag po'i 'od zer stong phrag 'gyed cing*/ smin ma dang sma ra 'bar ba ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ lto ba 'phyang zhing sbom la thung ba sha rgyas pa g.yas brkyang ba'i phyed skyil gyis ra skyes kyi steng na bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs dkar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa me mtshams nas badz+wa ya mā dzaḥ zhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya bya/ rtse gsum gyi phyag rgya dang bcas la/ hūm̐: dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: tshur gshegs tshur gshegs 'byung po che: me lha drang srong bram ze mchog: sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes su gsol: 'bar ba'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol: a la la te dgyes par mdzod: e h+ya hi bha ga wan ma ha ka ru ṇi ka dṛ sh+ya ho:(285)sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: ag+ne dza dza: ag+ne dhe wa shri hūm̐ dza: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho: sa ma ya s+t+wa: zhes spyan drangs shing gdan 'bul/ hūm̐: me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog: drag po'i don la dam tshig dgongs: gzi brjid che bas thugs rje ldan: bdag cag gus pas khyod phyag 'tshal: oṃ ag+ne ye dhe wa a ti pu hoḥ pra tits+tsha hoḥ sa phyag byas/ hūm̐: drang srong me lha 'khor bcas la: mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog spos: sgron me dri chab zhal zas sgra: 'bul gyis drag po'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ ag+ne ye dhe wa rā dza ar+ghaṃ pu dza hūm̐: sogs nas shab+ta 'i bar gyis phyi mchod 'bul/ hūm̐: drang srong chen por sngon chad ma bstar ba'i: ting 'dzin dbang bsgyur zhal zas bdud rtsi 'di: dag cing gtsang mar sbyar te 'bul lags kyi: ye shes thugs rjes dgongs nas bzhes su gsol: oṃ ag+ne dhe wa rā dza pu dza khā hi: sarba pañtsa (286)a mṛ ta khā hi: ma hā ba ling+ta khā hi: ma hā rak+ta khā hi: zhes nang mchod 'bul/ hūm̐: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos: 'dod yon mi zad nam 'kha'i mdzod:

longs spyod tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di: me lha 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: ag+ne dhe wa rā dza gā na tsakra pu dza khā hi: zhes tshogs phud 'bul/ hūm̐: me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog: mnyam pa'i ngang las kun snang yangs: chos nyid ngang las ma g.yos pa'i: ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces bstod/ byon zan ni/ me lha'i ljags rdo rje rtse gcig pa la raṃ/ dgangs blugs kyi rtse la hūm̐ yig nag po re res mtshan par gyur/ a ag+ne ye swa hāḥ brjod cing blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang ste pus mo'i kha las lag pa gnyis kyis mi 'da' bar lag gnyis mthe bong nang du bcug mthe'u chung sbreng ba'i khro bo'i khu tshur gyi phyag rgyas gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar nas g.yon du bskor zhing*/ ag+ne ye dhi bya dhi bya bi shudhe ma hā shṝ ha bya ka bya ba ha na yeḥ bdag cag dpon slob (287)rgyu sbyor rnams la gnod par byed pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar gcod/ khyad par dam sri rgyal 'gong 'byung po che ge mo mā ra ya rbad/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ na moḥrig pa'i rgyal po drang srong me lha chen po khyed kyis las thams cad byed pas sreg rdzas lha'i zhal du 'bul ba/ me nyid ye shes kyi mer byin gyis brlabs nas bdag gi phrin las sgrub par mdzad du gsol/ bdag cag la gnod pa'i bgegs thams cad brlag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod/ bsreg rdzas rnams kyang lag g.yon gyis 'bul te yams shing ni/ oṃ ag+ne ye bdag cag dpon slob sogs nas mā ra ya rbad/ ces pa'i bar gyis 'bul/ mar khur/ oṃ ag+ne ye bdag cag dpon slob sogs spel tshig gong dang 'dra bas dbul/ skyogs kyi nang du mar nag bkol tshad ran par byas/ shog ling gcig skam pas bzung nas steng du 'phyar/ dgug gzhug lan gcig gam gsum ci rigs par bya/ hoḥ me lha drag po gdangs pa'i zhal nang du: gnod byed 'byung po che ge mo 'di stobs kyi:

lus srog mthu stobs thal bar (288)bsregs byas nas: rjes med rlung la bskur ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ ag+ne ye che ge mo'i lus srog mthu stobs thams cad mā ra ya dz+wa la raṃ khā hiḥ zhes rtsa ba'i rdzas dbul/ hūm̐: ag+ne rā dza 'khor bcas la: sman raka dpal bshos drag po'i rdzas: zhal du stobs so bar chod bgegs: mchod par 'bul lo kha raṃ khā hiḥ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ag+ne ye che ge dz+wa la raṃ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa: ces drag po'i rdzas dang go rdzas bar grangs su bcad de 'bul/ gong bzhin bstod pa bya/ hūm̐: me lha 'khor bcas khyed rnams kyis: gnod byed 'byung po bgegs kyi tshogs: lus pa med pa tshar gcod pa'i: drag po'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod: ces gsol ba btab/ ye shes me lha phar gshegs shar lho nas: tshur gzigs phrin las sgrub pa'i dpang po mdzod: ag+ne dz+wa la gats+tsha muḥ 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ dam tshig me lha'i lto ba yangs pa'i nang : bh+rum̐ las dbang drag rol pa'i gzhal yas khangaḥ sogs nas (289) lha bskyed/ spyan 'dren/ bzhugs gsol yan grub mtshams/ oṃ shri ma hā kro dha rā dza sa pa ra wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha swa hā/ zhes dang*/ pang+yaṃ sbyar ba bcas kyi chu gnyis phul/ de nas phyag 'tshal/ mchod pa/ a ra li khā hiḥ zhes pa'i rjes su/ hūm̐: gnod byed dam sri 'byung po sgrol ba'i phyir: che mchog pad+ma drag po 'khor bcas la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa dam pa 'bul: 'chol ba'i khro rgyal zhal du kha raṃ khā hi: gha na tsakra kha raṃ khā hi: zhes tshogs 'bul/ ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi sku: sogs kyis bstod/ gtso 'khor kun kyang sku mdog rtsa ba'i zhal: mig sman mdog can shin tu khro zhing rngams: stong zil ltar gnag 'tsher ba'i 'od 'phro ba: drag po'i las kun mdzad pa'i rnam par gyur: zhes gsal btab byon zan ni/ (290) ye shes kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi ljags rdo rje rtse gcig pa la raṃ/

dgangs blugs kyi rtse la hūm̐ yig nag po re res mtshan par gyur/ hūm̐: chos nyid brdal ba chen po'i hom khung du: rig pa byang chub sems kyi me sbar te: gzung 'dzin 'khor ba'i bag chags sregs pa dang: dbang drag lha tshogs thugs dam skong ba'i phyir: dug gsum sha khrag rdzas chen 'di 'bul gyi: mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod: rtsa sngags bdun gyis dgangs gzar bkang nas/ ag+ne ye dhi bya dhi bya shudhe ma hā shri ha bya ka bya ba ha na ye bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor rnams la gnod par byed pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad khyad par dam sri rgyal 'gong 'byung po a mu ka ra mā ra ya rbad/ lan gsum/ hūm̐ bh+yo: bde chen chos dbyings sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i sku: sogs bskul pa nas gdab las/ hur thuṃ dza mā ra ya rbadaḥ bar gyis kiṅga rnams dum bur gtubs la/ hūm̐: che mchog pad+ma rdo rje gro bo lod: gnam sa lta bur gdangs pa'i zhal nang du: ye shes zhun chen mar nag liṅga dang : sha khrag tshil rus dug tshwa ro thal skra: tsha ba gsum dang til (291)yungs gsod rdzas 'bul: gnod byed thal bar rlog la rtsad nas chod: mthu stobs nus pa drung phyung gnad la phob: zug gzer na tsha drag pos kha phung thongs: rgyab brten byed pa'i lha 'dre rang gshed phob: yid dang dbang po rgyal 'bogs myos su chug: srog rtsa dmar po dum bur bcad nas kyang : dmigs pa'i gdon 'di myur du brlag gyur cig: ces spyir bskul/ bye brag tu/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ 'og min gsang chen rol pa'i zhing khams nas: rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: mtshan mchog brgyad dang rnam 'phrul dpag tu med: zhi dang khro bo'i rnam 'gyur bsam mi khyab: lhag pa'i lha mchog rdo rje gro bo lod: sreg blug drag po'i mchod pa 'di 'bul gyi: gnod byed 'byung po dam sri rgyal 'gong rnams: ming tsam brda tsam du yang mi grags pa'i:

mngon spyod rtags kyi phrin las myur du sgrubs: rtsa sngags mjug tu/ oṃ badz+ra rak+sha sogs bsad sngags (292) btags pa'i mthar/ bdag cag dpon slob= sbyar bas yams shing dang mar khu 'bul/ de nas snum dang liṅga sogs sngar ltar la/ 'gugs pa dang bcas/ hoḥ che mchog pad+ma drag po'i zhal nang du: gnod byed 'byung po a mu ka stobs kyi: lus srog mthu stobs thal bar bsregs byas nas: rjes med rlung la bskur ba'i phrin las mdzod: rtsa sngags dang bsad sngags sbrel mas liṅga 'bul/ de nas drag po'i rdzas nas tsha rdzas bar rnams rtsa sngags bsad sngags gsham du/ gnod byed a mu ka'i lus ngag yid gsum mthu stobs nus pa thams cad mā ra ya dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: ces grangs su bcad de 'bul/ de bzhin du/ hūm̐ bh+yo: thugs kar zla gam gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: gar gyi dbang phyug rta mchog he ru ka: pad+ma gzi ldan rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum: sras dang sprul pa bsam mi khyab pa la: sreg blug drag po'i=

sogs dang*/ sngags/ oṃ pad+ma krita h+ya gṛ ba hūm̐ḥ la las sngags btags pa dang*/ ho: dbang chen rta mchog rol pa'i gzhal nang du: sogs 'bul tshul gong ltar/ hūm̐ bh+yo:(293)chos dbyings ye shes rnam snang gang chen mtsho: rdo rje slob dpon budha thod phreng rtsal: me long ye shes rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: mnyam nyid ye shes rad+na thod phreng rtsal: sor rtog ye shes pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: bya grub ye shes karma thod phreng rtsal: rigs bzhi'i ging chen mkha' 'gro'i 'khor dang bcas: phrin las bzhi sgrub sgo skyong bcas pa la: sreg blugs drag po'i= oṃ pad+ma ta krita h+ya gh+ri wa hūm̐: oṃ badz+ra shri gro bo lod sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes bsnyen bsgrub gsham du las sngags sbyar ba dang*/ ho: thod phreng sde lnga rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro ging : sgo skyong pho nyar bcas pa'i zhal nang du: sogs 'bul tshul gong ltar ro/ 'jug pa bde bar byed na/ dmigs pa'i gdon 'di myur du brlag gyur cig: zhes pa'i 'phros su/ hūm̐: dbang chen rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: dpal chen rta mgrin rdo rje gro bo lod: sras dang sprul pa'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas la: sreg blugs drag po'i= sogs dang*/ sngags bsnyen sgrub (294) las gsum la/ ho: dbang drag dkyil 'khor lha tshogs zhal nang du: sogs kyis 'thus so/ de nas thab kyi steng du lcags sgyed btsugs/ slang ngar mar nag bkol pa'i me lces sleb pa'i sar 'khor ling chen mo nam 'khar bla bre ltar bskyang ste/ hūm̐ bh+yo: bde chen chos dbyings sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i sku: sogs thugs dam bskul/ gser skyems/ bden bdar 'gugs bzhug bya/ de nas/ hoḥ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ 'jam dpal sku'i lha tshogs rnams dang*/ pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ bdud rtsi yon tan gyi lha tshogs rnams dang*/

phur pa phrin las kyi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ ma mo rbod gtong gi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ rig 'dzin slob dpon gyi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ 'jig rten mchod bstod kyi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ dmod pa drag sngags kyi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ dam can chos srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa dgongs su gsol/ gnod byed 'byung po che ge mo 'dis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa thos bsam sgom gsum byed pa la bar du gcod de mdo sngags kyi sde (295)rnams dkrugs shing mi mthun par byas so/ sngags 'chang rnal 'byor pa bdag la tho 'tshams so/ 'gro ba rnams kyi sha khrag brkus shing sha khrag hab sha byas so/ bsod nams dang mnga' thang nyams su bcug go lo thog la sad ser btsa' than phab bo/ mi phyugs la nad rims char ltar btang ngo*/ khyad par rgyu sbyor che ge mo mi nor 'khor g.yog dang bcas par mi 'dod sna dgus mnar ro/ bdag sogs rnams kyi gnod byed 'di la dang po khas ma nyes/ bar du lag gis ma nyes/ tha ma spyod pas ma nyes so/ rgyal khams phung ba'i phung 'dre 'di nyid tshar gcod pa'i dus la babs pas/ rtsa gsum lha tshogs rnams kyis nyes kyi ltongs zungs/ bden rdzun gyi shags phye/ mthu stobs nus pa'i rtsal bskyed la da lta nyid du tshar gcod pa'i phrin las mdzod/ khyad par che mchog pad+ma rdo rje gro bo lod/ dbang chen rta mchog rol pa/ yum chen pad+ma (296)gzi ldan/ ye shes kyi bya khyung ga ru ṭa/ budha thod phreng rtsal/ badz+ra thod phreng rtsal/ rad+na thod phreng rtsal/ pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ karma thod phreng rtsal/ rigs bzhi'i ging chen yab yum/ gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'gugs 'ching sdom myos mdzad pa'i sgo ma/ sprul pa yang sprul las byed dang bcas pa'i lha tshogs rnams nyi zla lta bu'i spyan gyis gzigs/ gnam sa lta bu'i zhal gdangs/ gangs ri lta bu'i mche ba gtsigs/ glog dmar lta bu'i ljags brkyongs la/

ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥphaṭaḥkyi nga ro drag po dang bcas te gdon bgegs 'byung po che ge g.yog 'khor sde dpung dang bcas pa da lta nyid du zhal du bzhes la lhag ma tsam yang ma lus par sgrol ba'i las mdzod cig bsnyen sgrub las sngags sham du/ oṃ ag+na ye dz+wa la raṃ khā hiḥ zhes chang gar ma lhug thengs len gsum dang bcas hom mchod rgyas par bya'o/ gshegs skyems ni/ byon zan ji lta ba bzhin (297) 'bul/ hūm̐: che mchog pad+ma drag po 'khor bcas la: khyad par mchod pa pañtsa a mṛ ta: ma hā bā ling rak+ta mchod par 'bul: bzhes nas bla med dngos grub stsal du gsol: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ= sogs dang*/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hiḥ ma hā rak+ta khā hiḥ mahā ba ling+ta khā hiḥ zhes sman raka gtor ma stob/ oṃ badz+ra tam+bu la ye swa hā ཿsa so tsi dang*/ oṃ badz+ra was+t+ra ye swa hāḥ sa gos zung 'bul/ 'gro ba'i don du rang byung 'od dpag med: bkra shis yon tan du mas brgyan pa'i sku: 'jig rten mnga' bsgyur pad+ma rgyal po'i sras: rdo rje gro lod rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod: zhes pas bstod/ 'dod don gsol ba ni/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ 'og min gsang chen rol pa'i dur khrod du: sogs bzlog pa tshar gcig 'phros/ bdag dang sems can las kyis mnar zhing gzir: ma rig dbang gis smin po rgyud lngar 'khyams: log rtog ngan pa'i dbang bsgyur 'gal 'khrul (298)rnams: ye shes gzigs mnga' 'phags pa'i tshogs la bshags: yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ oṃ:khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad: rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub bstsol: sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang : slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol: badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs: dam tshig pa rang gi snying gar thim par gyur: 'j-ig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ dpang por bzhugs pa'i ye shes kyi: me lha badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ slar yang dam tshig sems dpa' dang : dbyer med ngo bo gcig tu gyur:

a ag+na ye dhe ba rā dza ar+ghaṃ pu dza hūm̐: sogs dang*/ shab+ta 'i bar dang*/ hūm̐: me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog: mnyam pa'i ngang las kun snang yang : chos nyid ngang las ma g.yos pa'i: ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: zhes mchod cing bstod/ oṃ ag+na ye bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor rnams la gnod par byed pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar gcod khyad par dam sri rgyal 'gong 'byung po a (299)mu ka mā ra ya rbadaḥ zhes pas yams shing dang*/ mar khu 'bul/ a ag+ne ye gnod byed a mu ka'i lus ngag yid gsum mthu stobs thams cad mā ra ya dz+wa la raṃ khā hiḥ zhes pa'i rtsa sngags kyis rdzas dang*/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ag+na ye a mu ka dz+wa la raṃ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces pas drag po'i rdzas nas tsha rdzas bar dbul/ oṃ ag+na ye swa hāḥ lan bdun/ oṃ ag+na ye dhi bya dhi bya bi shudhe ma hā shri ha bya ka bya ba ha na ye bdag cag= sogs spel tshig gong ltar sbyar ba lan gsum gyis gshegs skyems 'bul/ badz+ra tam+bu la= so rtsi dang*/ was+t+ra sa gos zung dbul/ gtor ma/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ aḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ sa brlab/ oṃ ag+ne ye sa pā ri ba ra ma hā ba ling+ta ta pu dza khā hiḥ lan gsum gyis 'bul/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bdag cag sogs kyis 'dod gsol bya/ oṃ ag+ne ye ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha swa hāḥ nas/ shab+ta 'i bar gyis bachod/ me ste sreg bya= sogs kyis bstod/ yig brgya dang*/ ma rnyed yongs su ma tshangs dang : sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ (300)bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// byin khyod kyis bsgrubs kyis gshegs// ji bzhin dus su tshur byon zhing*// bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs/ oṃ ag+ne ya hi gats+tsha: ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang la thim par gyur/ sgrub pa po rnams lag g.yas steng du byas/ srin lag sbrel nas gral gru gsum gyi tshul du/

hūm̐:e yi dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: sogs dang*/ sum+bha ni brjod/ me long skabs yod kyang mi bzhag par dug khrag gi chus bsad pa'i thal ba thugs dam bskul zhing zlog pa'i thal rdebs dang 'brel bar dgra phyogs su rlung la bskur ba'am/ yang na thal sol rnams snod nang du blugs la mchod rten nas lam rgya gram du mnan no/ las byang gi mjug bsdu'o/ 'jam dbyangs mi pham gsungs rab las/ dmigs gsal dgra bgegs bsad pa la dgra la dmigs bya'i dri ma rjes sa dang bgegs la gnas rten gyi sa sogs bsres pa'i dug khrag mi skra mi rus phub ma sogs kyis liṅga ming rus ldan pa grangs mar bsreg te/ lha rnams kyis dgra bgegs bkug nas mtshon gyis gtubs te sha khrag lhag med du rol bar bsam/ sngags sham du/ dgra bgegs che ge mo/ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ zhes btags pa'i rdzas 'bul brgya'am stong la sogs pa grangs bsogs/ mngon spyod kyi bskrad pa la (301) khwa dang 'ug pa'i sgro gtso bor gyur pa'i rdzas la sbyin sreg bya ba ni/ dmigs pa ni/ yam̐ las byung ba'i rlung dkyil nag po gzhu yi dbyibs can la gnas pa'i rnga mo sngon mo rlung gi shugs can la dmigs bya bskyon te sprul pa'i khro bo'i tshogs kyis ded nas lho yi phyogs su shog skya rlung gis khyer ba ltar phyi mig tsam yang blta ba'i dbang med par mtha' med du bskrad par bsam/ rtsa sngags sham du/ che ge mo suts+tsha ta ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ zhes sbyar/ dbye ba la/ nel ma'i lo ma sbrul shun khwa dang 'ug pa'i tshang nas byung pa'i rdzas bsreg cing*/ lha rnams kyis sprul pa'i bya rog dang 'ug pa'i mgo can ra dang ma he la zhon pa dbye yul rnams kyi snying la zhugs pas phan tshun shin tu mi mthun pa'i sems rtsub mos 'thab 'dzing mtshon gyis 'khrugs nas 'ur zing langs par bsam la/ sngags mthar/ che ge mo 'di dang che ge mo 'di gnyis bi de ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa:

zhes btags la bzla/ drag po'i 'gugs pa ni/ dha dhu ra dang ka ra wi ra khrag dang bcas pa'i me tog dmar po sogs sreg rdzas sreg cing*/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i seṅge dmar po'i steng du sgrub bya gcer pu skra grol ba la sprul pa'i pho nyas lcags kyus snying la btab/ zhags pas mgul nas bcings te rlung shugs kyis rang dbang med par 'ong bar bsam/ rtsa sngags la/ che ge mo a kar ṣa ya dza: zhes btags so// (302) rengs shing gnon pa'i las la yung ba sdong ros ba bla dang phug ron sbal pa lug dang nya la sogs pa'i sha dang bag phye dang 'bru sna dang dug khrag sna'i rdzas gang rnyed sreg cing*/ lha rnams dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i 'od zer ser po 'phro bar gsal ba'i mdun du sa gzhir dmigs bya bsgyel ba'i snying gar ri rab dang de steng sna tshogs rdo rje/ de steng sa dkyil ri phran rol mtsho dang bcas pa kha thur du bstan pas mnan cing de steng 'byung rim ri rab lha'i pho brang bcas te ldang med du bsam la/ sngags shams du/ che ge mo s+t+wam+bha ya ku ru lam: zhais bzlas/ ngag gnon na gzhan rengs dang 'dra la lce steng*/ dkyil ri rab dang rdo rje rgya gram gyis mnan par gsal gdab nas/ sngags shams du/ che ge mo'i ngag s+t+waṃ bha na ku ru lam: zhes bzla'o/ rmongs pa la'ang rengs ba dang 'dra la/ lha rnams kyi 'od nag pos dmigs bya'i lus ngag yid gsum 'o ma rul pa bzhin du nag thibs se smug cing dran pa nyams par bsam la/ che ge mo ha ya nan/ zhes bzla/ smyo bar byed pa la/ dha dhu ra sogs dug khrag tsha ba'i mar khu dang sha chen dang bya rgod sha sogs sreg cing*/ lha rnams las smyo dug gi char babs pa dmigs bya'i snying khar thib pas dran pa nyams cing dbang med du smyo bar bsam la/ sngags shams du/ che ge mo un+ma da hūm̐ phaṭa: zhes bzlas/ drag po'i cho 'phrul gtong ba la ltas ngan pa'i srog chags kyi sha gtso bor gyur pa'i sha sna dang dug khrag gi

(303) rdzas sreg cing*/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi sku las sprul pa'i pho nya 'jigs su rung pas dgra bo'i khyim thams cad du ltas ngan gyi yo lang 'khrugs te than gyi dmag tshogs mun pa ltar gtibs par bsam la/ sngags shams du/ li phrim raṃ ka ra rma ri she'u re'u he dun rtsa phob khyung rtsa he phaṭa: zhes btags la bzla'o/ de yang spyir las so sor sgrub na las thogs pa med pa'i rdzas de dag phul bas lha mnyes pa'i 'od zer gyis las gang 'dod 'grub pa dang*/ sngags dang dmigs pa 'dod gsol sogs 'das ma 'das gnyis kar kha bsgyur te sbyar dgos pa ni kun tu shes par bya'o/ rdzas rdzogs rjes me thun brdeg na/ dpal chen sku las me dpung rnam lnga 'bar// me lce khro chung yang sprul mtshon cha yis// tshwa tshwas 'phros pas nad gdon sdig sgrib sregs// bar chad gdon bgegs brlag cing bcom par gyur/ drag sngags mthar/ gnod byed dam sri pho mo'i srog la raṃ raṃ: tsit+ta raṃ raṃ thul thul: dz+nyā na a na la tsakra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa: sgrub pa la bar chad byed pa thams cad mā ra ya dz+wa la raṃ raṃ uts+tsha ta ya phaṭa: sarba in+taṃ ra shin+taṃ ku ru hūm̐ phaṭa raṃ swa hā:(304) zhes sbyar ro/ sgrub dkyil dang 'brel na/ rtsa sngags mthar/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gtso bo las mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du las kyi he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par thon nas sbyin sreg gi las rim la 'jug par mos pa dang*/ 'das pa'i me lha mtshon pa'i skabs gzhal yas khang gdan bskyed pa yan song mtshams/ dkyil 'khor nas tshom bu spyan drangs pa dang chabs gcig spyan 'dren dang*/ sngags tsam gyis bzhugs su gsol/ lha bskyed bton la gsol gdab/ chu gnyis 'bul ba yan sngar ltar/ gshegs gsol skabs tshom bu slar bskyel ba khyad par ro/ dmigs yul gshin po'i don du chags chen 'khrul pa sbubs bshig gi gshed 'dul bya na/

me ri rab 'bar las/ drag po'i sbyin sreg lha bskyed mchod de bskul// tshe 'das srog gcod dbugs len bla khyer dang*// mdangs 'phrog za 'dre shi gshed gzugs la dbab// 'dzin sdom myos byed drag po'i thun gyis 'dul/ zhes gsungs pas drag po'i sbyin sreg gong du bshad pa ltar la/ 'dod gsol kha bsgyur/ tshe las 'das pa gson gyis dus su tshe la bar du gcod cing gshin gyi dus su sdig pa sbyong ba la bar du gcod pa'i za 'dre shi gshed thams cad (305) zhes pa dang*/ gnod byed za 'dre shi gshed zhes dang*/ gnod byed 'byung po za 'dre shi gshed sogs skabs gang babs dang*/ hom mchod skabs/ dgongs su gsol= zhes pa'i rjes su/ tshe las 'das pa la dang po nad kyi sna 'dren pa/ bar du gdon gyi tshang bca' ba/ tha ma nad la mi phan par byed pa/ shi khar dbugs sdud cing phung po la bdag tu bzung pa/ gshin po gnas mi bde zhing gson po bkra mi shis par byed pa ma rig gdon gzugs su shar ba'i za 'dre shi gshed 'di rnams/ zhi bas gdul du mi 'tshal bas snying rje khros pa'i drag shul 'bar ba chen pos las ngan gyi rgyun bcad/ nyon mongs pa'i drwa ba gzhoms/ bag chags kyi sbubs bshig gzugs phung gdan du bzhes/ rnam shes he ru ka'i thugs klong du bstim ste ming tsam yang mi grags par mdzad du gsol/ khyad par che mchog pad+ma rdo rje gro bo lod

sogs nas/ nga ro drag po dang bcas te tshe la 'das (306)pa'i thar lam la bar du gcod pa'i za 'dre shi gshed 'khrul snang bag chags dang bcas pa da lta nyid du zhal du bzhes la sogs kha bsgyur gang dgos rigs pas 'phrul lo// 'jig dus zhugs kyis ri dang rgya mtsho bzhin// ldog med rdo rje ye shes 'bar ba'i mes// bar chad bdud bgegs ming med lhag med par// gzhil nas bde legs snang bas kun khyab shog ces kun gzigs lnga pa chen po sogs tshad ma'i dam pa rnams kyi legs bshad(rgya can gro lod )bzhin kun mkhyen chen po ngag gi dbang pos rjes su bzung ba dpal chen 'dus pas bsdebs pa dge legs 'phel/// /
